readmeExcerpt: A python framework for qubit simulations and optimal control. This code provides classes to assist in setting up Hamiltonians for multi-qubit superconducting qubit simulations. After setting up the system there is both a pure python and a C++ implementation of an open and closed system simulator and an optimal control module based on the GRAPE algorithm. The C++ backend relies on the Eigen library for matrix manipulations and eignsolvers. These are the latest versions I have worked with. Nearby versions should be just fine too.
